main.summary: Writable stream wrapper that hashes every written byte while forwarding operations to an underlying destination stream.

field.name: Destination
field.summary: The underlying destination stream that receives forwarded write operations.

field.name: Hash
field.summary: The incremental SHA-512 hash state fed by each forwarded write.

field.name: LeaveOpen
field.summary: True when the underlying destination stream should remain open when this wrapper is disposed.

field.name: Finalized
field.summary: True once the current hash value has been finalized and retrieved.

field.name: disposed
field.summary: Tracks whether the stream has been disposed.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a hashing write wrapper over an existing destination stream.
constructor.param: The destination stream that receives forwarded writes.
True to leave the destination stream open when the hashing wrapper is disposed; otherwise false.

method.name: GetHashAndReset
method.summary: Finalize and return the current SHA-512 digest for all bytes written so far.

property.name: CanRead
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the underlying destination stream supports reading.

property.name: CanSeek
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the underlying destination stream supports seeking.

property.name: CanWrite
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the underlying destination stream supports writing.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Gets the length of the underlying destination stream.

property.name: Position
property.summary: Gets or sets the current position within the underlying destination stream.

method.name: FlushAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously flush the underlying destination stream.
method.returns: A task that completes when the underlying flush operation completes.

method.name: Read
method.summary: Read from the underlying destination stream.
method.param: Destination buffer for the read bytes.
Start offset in the destination buffer.
Maximum number of bytes to read.
method.returns: The number of bytes read from the underlying destination stream.

method.name: Seek
method.summary: Change the position within the underlying destination stream.
method.param: Reference point used to obtain the new position.
method.returns: The new position within the underlying destination stream.

method.name: SetLength
method.summary: Set the length of the underlying destination stream.
method.param: The desired length of the stream.

method.name: Write
method.summary: Write bytes to the underlying destination stream and append them to the incremental SHA-512 state.
method.param: Source buffer containing bytes to write.
Start offset in the source buffer.

method.name: WriteByte
method.summary: Write a single byte to the underlying destination stream and append it to the incremental SHA-512 state.

method.name: WriteAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously write bytes to the underlying destination stream and append them to the incremental SHA-512 state.
method.param: Source buffer containing bytes to write.
Start offset in the source buffer.
method.returns: A task that completes when the write operation and hash append complete.

method.name: WriteAsyncMemory
method.summary: Asynchronously write memory-backed bytes to the underlying destination stream and append them to the incremental SHA-512 state.
method.param: Source memory containing bytes to write.
method.returns: A task-like value that completes when the write operation and hash append complete.
